rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when perform means to do or execute something, such as an experiment.

example.english: We perform an experiment in class.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng5 tong4 zou6 sat6 jim6

rows.note: Use this when someone performs for an audience through acting, music, or another show.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 biu2 jin2

rows.note: Use this for how a person performs or behaves, especially in phrases such as 表現得好.

example.english: You perform very well this time.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 biu2 jin6 dak1 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use this in formal contexts when someone fulfills the obligations or terms of a contract.

example.english: The company will perform its obligations under the contract.
example.traditional: 公司會履行合約上嘅責任。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 lei5 hang4 hap6 joek3 soeng6 ge3 zaak3 jam6
